verdict_hint: Primary metric is c-negative (co-occurrence-controlled). SAE wins specificity if, at comparable median_on_target_r, its median_specificity_ratio_cneg > diff_in_means and its median_n_off_sig_cneg < diff_in_means. The *_allnotes fields are the confounded cross-check that should reconcile with a plain correlation matrix (e.g. the .tmp vanilla all-notes ratio).
